The entire diff is `harness/copilot-sdk-verified.json:2`: version `1.0.114-0` to `1.0.115-1`. Exact base/head comparison confirms every other byte, including the seven-check list, is unchanged. No added secret or machine path; no runtime behavior, dependency, loop or launch site changes.
